severity_assessment: HIGH payroll recovery availability; no duplicate payroll disbursement demonstrated.

evidence.evidence: Transition/pay restore in initializers; constructor sets session/date only, not SelectedRun or IsPayOpen.
CanAdvance requires NextStatus derived from null SelectedRun. CanOpenPay requires CanEditAction, false for any recovered request.
Public LoadAsync refuses retained request; only private ReloadAsync would populate Runs/SelectedRun.
SelectRun requires CanEditAction; create-run is a counterexample with explicit retained retry, but rejects transition/pay pending.
AdvanceRunAsync checks CanAdvance before looking at retained transition; authoritative monotonic read fallback exists but unreachable on fresh VM.
OpenPay requires CanOpenPay; PayRunAsync checks IsPayOpen before recovered DTO, and fresh value is false.
Advance action visibility derived from null NextStatusLabel, payment entry depends on selected approved run.
Pay retry control nested under transient IsPayOpen overlay.
Management pending registration happens only when IsBusy changes; constructor does not notify. Thus global lock/navigation freeze is not established merely by recovered request.

preconditions: Unresolved transition or payroll payment DTO survives process restart.
Reopening payroll constructs fresh VM; no external injected transient selection/dialog state.
counterevidence: Same-process transition/payment preserves context and has idempotent/reconciliation handling.
Create payroll run has separate explicit retained retry and is not affected by this exact recovery defect.
No constructor call registers recovered payroll as a global management operation; do not overclaim globally blocked navigation/close.
No database restore, payroll write, or payout executed.
recommended_remediation: Route retained transition/pay by original run identity through explicit recovery actions independent of transient selection/pay modal; register recovered pending state consistently.
required_tests: Fresh VM with retained transition exposes retry even when Runs empty and SelectedRun null.
Fresh VM with retained pay exposes original payment context without allowing new account choice.
Assert constructor pending registration and navigation rules separately from action reachability.
method: Independent manual source and XAML reachability challenge; no runtime interaction
independent_scope: Finding-local review, not exhaustive file/function certification
